name: SAST Tool Configuration & Operation
description: Configuration, operation, and management of static application security testing (SAST) tools. Covers tool selection for target languages, rule configuration, scan profile tuning, CI/CD integration, and result export for downstream triage.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose and capabilities of SAST tools
evidence: Can explain how SAST tools analyze source code or bytecode
Familiar with major SAST tools (Semgrep, CodeQL, SonarQube, Checkmarx)
Understands the difference between SAST and manual code review

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs SAST scans under supervision with default configurations
evidence: Executed SAST scans using at least 2 tools on lab projects
Configured basic scan profiles for target languages
Exported and organized scan results for triage review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently configures and operates SAST tools for engagements
evidence: Independently configured and ran SAST scans on 5+ engagements
Tunes scan profiles to reduce noise for specific technology stacks
Integrates SAST tools into CI/CD pipelines
Passed proficiency assessment on SAST tool operation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Optimizes SAST deployments; compares tool effectiveness; develops custom configurations
evidence: Benchmarks SAST tools against known vulnerability sets for detection rates
Develops custom scan profiles for organization-specific technology stacks
Integrates multiple SAST tools and correlates results
Mentors junior analysts on SAST tool selection and configuration

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on SAST tooling; evaluates and selects tools for the lab
evidence: Led SAST tool evaluation and selection for the lab
Developed lab methodology for SAST tool deployment and operation
Contributes to SAST tool vendor improvement through bug reports or feature requests
Trains teams on SAST tool administration and optimization

assessment_methods.description: Configure and run SAST scans on a prepared project, tuning rules to minimize false positives
Observe tool configuration, scan execution, and result export workflow
